documents.title: SEO Services, Social Media Management & Creative Content Marketing
documents.clientAddress:
Office # 09, DMC-L-A Madinat Dubai Almelaheyah
Dubai Maritime City, Dubai, UAE
documents.overview:
Following up on consultations with Mr. Osama Hassan regarding scaling Vista Maritime across Pakistan and the UAE diaspora, this proposal establishes a unified 3-service digital growth ecosystem.

Vista Maritime possesses extraordinary institutional advantages: physical operational branches in prime commercial corridors (DHA Karachi & DHA Islamabad), a direct Dubai DMC hub in Dubai Maritime City, and specialized domain expertise in Corporate Travel and Seafarer Logistics.

Our unified service offering directly capitalizes on these strengths through three interconnected pillars:

• SEO SERVICES: Implementing a structured technical and on-page SEO program to capture high-intent commercial keywords, optimize local Google Business Profiles across Karachi and Islamabad, and establish long-term search dominance.

• SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGEMENT: Building a prestigious, consistent social presence across Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn with monthly content calendars, static/carousel creative design, copywriting, and active community engagement.

• CREATIVE CONTENT MARKETING: Producing high-impact visual storytelling, short-form video concepts (Reels/TikTok) with viral hooks, educational authority carousels, and promotional campaign assets that convert viewers into booked clients.
documents.requirements:
• Scale organic visibility across Pakistan & UAE maritime corridors
• Establish prestigious, multi-channel social media brand presence
• Drive qualified corporate travel & seafarer booking conversions
documents.proposedSolution: Integrated 3-pillar digital growth engine combining technical & local SEO, high-authority social media management, and performance creative content. Designed to capture high-intent search traffic across DHA Karachi, Islamabad, and Dubai DMC while converting regional audiences through premium visual storytelling.
documents.scopeOfWork:
• SEO Engine: Technical audit, on-page optimization, high-intent maritime keyword targeting & GBP setups (DHA Karachi, Islamabad, Dubai DMC)
• Social Media Infrastructure: Brand identity consistency, platform setup (LinkedIn, IG, FB), monthly content calendar & community management
• Creative Content Production: High-impact static/carousel graphics, promotional assets, short-form video scripts & Reel/TikTok edits
• Campaign Strategy & Optimization: Performance analytics reporting, conversion path refinement, seafarer & corporate travel lead funnels
